svg.title: Black and White
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored SVG. Approximate geometry and vivid screen colours. Two curving white bands interrupt black rectangular field; observed top/bottom boundary contacts retained. Fine curvature approximated by eye from ordinary museum preview.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/88580; inspected2026-10-27. Approximation, not a facsimile.
